test_title: PYST 61: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 15th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: When twice of a number added to 3 is multiplied by 5 and added to the number itself, it gives 158. What is the square of that number?
solution:
Let the number be = X

Now, according to the question :-

 
• Twice of a number :

⇒X = 2x

 
• Added to 3 :​

⇒2x + 3

 
• Multiplied by 5

⇒(2x + 3) 5

 
• Added to the number itself

⇒[(2x + 3) 5] + X
